system_description: A simple demo app for testing the UI generation pipeline.

functional_requirements.title: User login
functional_requirements.description: Users can sign in with email and password.

functional_requirements.title: View dashboard
functional_requirements.description: Signed-in users can see a dashboard with summary cards.

non_functional_requirements.description: The UI must be keyboard accessible and meet WCAG 2.2 AA.
The UI must work well on mobile and desktop screens.
The UI should be simple, clear, and consistent.
